title: Model/Data Quality and Bias Drift with SageMaker Clarify [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on the tools for responsible AI.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到負責任 AI 工具實作。

cues.en: In this tutorial, I'm gonna show you some features of SageMaker Clarify with, for example, bias and imbalance.
cues.zh: 展示 SageMaker Clarify 一些功能，例如偏見、不平衡。

cues.en: So before we start, just a quick disclaimer.
cues.zh: 開始先提醒。

cues.en: Please do not reproduce the tutorial because this would require you to create a new SageMaker domain, and we already did the cleanup.
cues.zh: 請不要重做，因為需要新 SageMaker 網域，之前已清理。

cues.en: Here, I just wanna show you those features, so no need to reproduce.
cues.zh: 只是展示，不需要實際重做。

cues.en: Feel free to just watch to get familiarized with these features of SageMaker.
cues.zh: 觀看、熟悉功能即可。

cues.en: Okay, so indeed, I created this new domain, then a new user profile, then I opened Canvas, which led me to Canvas.
cues.zh: 我建新網域、新設定檔，再開 Canvas。

cues.en: I created the same classification machine learning model that we created in the previous section.
cues.zh: 建立和上一節相同的分類模型。

cues.en: But this time, I also deployed it.
cues.zh: 但這次也部署。

cues.en: Indeed, if we click view and if we enter my machine learning model, well, remember that in the last step there is deploy.
cues.zh: 按 View 進模型，記得最後有 Deploy。

cues.en: So you can deploy it.
cues.zh: 可部署。

cues.en: And indeed, I deployed it as a SageMaker endpoint.
cues.zh: 我部署成 SageMaker 端點。

cues.en: And the reason why I did that is in order to see it in my SageMaker AI console.
cues.zh: 為了能在 SageMaker AI 主控台看到。

cues.en: Because indeed, in order to find features of clarify and monitor, well, you simply need to go to governance, which by the way, is a new feature.
cues.zh: 要找 Clarify、Monitor 功能，只到 Governance，順帶一提是新功能。

cues.en: As you can see, model dashboard, new, model cards, new.
cues.zh: Model dashboard、Model cards，都標 New。

cues.en: At the time I'm speaking, you won't find explicitly clarify or monitor.
cues.zh: 錄影當時不會明確看到 Clarify 或 Monitor 名稱。

cues.en: They work on the back end.
cues.zh: 在後端運作。

cues.en: But in order to see their features, well, you simply need to go to model dashboard here, and there you go, you will find the deployed model, the model that I just deployed, which is exactly this one.
cues.zh: 到 Model dashboard，就會找到剛部署的模型，就是這個。

cues.en: I think this is when I started deploying the model, as you can see.
cues.zh: 我想這是開始部署時的紀錄。

cues.en: And then once the model was deployed in the form of an endpoint, well, that gave the deployed model 30 seconds later, okay?
cues.zh: 端點完成，30 秒後又有部署完成的模型。

cues.en: And so as I was telling you, that's where you can find the features of clarify, such as model quality, data quality, bias drift, feature attribution drift, and some other data.
cues.zh: 這裡有 Clarify 相關功能，包括 Model quality、Data quality、Bias drift、Feature attribution drift，以及其他資料。

cues.en: But here I just deployed the model.
cues.zh: 但模型剛部署。

cues.en: I haven't used it yet, so I don't have much data, which is why we have nothing here.
cues.zh: 還沒使用，沒多少資料，所以這裡空白。

cues.en: But there you go, I just wanna show you where you can find these features of clarify in the SageMaker AI console.
cues.zh: 只是展示主控台功能在哪。

cues.en: All right, so that's it for this quick first hands-on tutorial on the tools for responsible AI with this governance feature here, model dashboard.
cues.zh: 第一個簡短實作到此，使用 Governance 的 Model dashboard。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
